_doc: Lyria prompts for the procedural sounds (tools/sfx/generate.py). kind: shot = separate takes cut apart, loop = one steady recording looped. Ids are public/sounds/manifest.json ids; files keep their names.

strider_step.sound: the footfall of a 40 metre tall monster on a city street: a huge sub-bass boom, the ground thumping, debris and windows rattling, a long rolling rumble

strider_roar.sound: a colossal monster roaring over a city like a giant kaiju: a deep bellow sliding up into a rasping, screeching upper tone, then a guttural fall, echoing off tall buildings

strider_charge.sound: a giant monster charging its energy breath: a rising electric hum that swells and builds with crackling static and sparks

strider_breath.sound: a giant monster's plasma breath attack: a roaring, tearing jet of fire and plasma rushing out with a sizzling, crackling top

tremor_rumble.sound: an earth tremor far away: the ground trembling with a low deep rumble, windows and loose things faintly rattling

car_alarm.sound: a parked car's alarm going off on a city street: an electronic whoop followed by a warbling siren pattern

civil_siren.sound: a civil defence evacuation siren, a mechanical motor siren winding up and down slowly over a whole city, echoing between buildings

nuke_siren.sound: an air raid attack warning, a mechanical motor siren wailing up and down quickly, a second rotor a fifth higher, echoing over a whole city

robot_glitch.sound: a robot malfunctioning: stuttering electronic bleeps at jumping pitches, bit-crushed digital buzz, a falling boop

robot_hostile.sound: a robot turning hostile: a servo motor whine winding up, then a harsh aggressive two-tone electronic chirp over an electric buzz

burrower_rumble.sound: a giant worm tunnelling right under a city street: deep earth rumble, rock grinding and crunching, slow surging

burrower_rumble_far.sound: a long low rumble from deep under a street, faint grinding of rock, swelling and fading away

burrower_breach.sound: a city street caving in: asphalt cracking and splitting, a deep collapse boom, then debris and rubble raining down

burrower_roar.sound: a giant sandworm monster's call: a chorus of shrieking grinding creature voices over a wet low gurgle, ending in a clicking rattle

burrower_slam.sound: a giant monster's head slamming down onto a street: a heavy ground thud, asphalt crunching, a rumbling tail

burrower_dive.sound: a giant worm diving back into the ground: a rush of air, soil and stones torn up, grinding rumble going away below

leviathan_surface.sound: a huge sea monster surfacing in a river: a deep surge of water heaving up, a big wash and spray splashing down

leviathan_roar.sound: a gigantic sea monster's call: a deep wet bellow with a whale-like moan and a gurgle, echoing over water

leviathan_slap.sound: a giant wet tentacle slapping down hard on a wooden deck: a heavy wet thud and splatter

roc_screech.sound: a gigantic eagle screaming: a harsh, rough raptor cry 'kee-eeer' falling in pitch, echoing off buildings
roc_screech.scene: Low angle shot of a gigantic eagle, as big as an airplane, swooping between skyscrapers and screaming

roc_cry_far.sound: a giant eagle's cry far away high in the sky, distant and dull, with a long echo
roc_cry_far.scene: Wide shot of a city skyline, a gigantic eagle circling far away high in the sky and crying

roc_flap.sound: a single beat of enormous wings: a great whoomp of air with a low thump

mech_step.sound: a giant robot mech's footstep: a deep heavy thud, steel clanging on steel, a hydraulic hiss

mech_launch.sound: a missile launching from a pod: a sharp pop and a tearing rush of rocket exhaust flying away

mech_cannon.sound: a short burst of a rotary cannon: rapid hard gunshots over a spinning motor whine

mech_vent.sound: a giant machine's heat vents opening: a heavy metal clunk and a long roaring hiss of steam

mech_alarm.sound: a giant war machine's warning klaxon: a blaring two-tone horn, echoing off buildings

brood_chitter.sound: a swarm of insect-like creatures: dry clicking, rasping and chirping from many small bodies, claws scrabbling on stone

brood_screech.sound: a small insect monster shrieking: a short rasping squeal

brood_bite.sound: a quick snap of insect mandibles with a crunch, very short

army_rifle.sound: a squad of soldiers firing assault rifles: a ragged burst of sharp gunshot cracks slapping off city walls

army_autocannon.sound: an armoured vehicle's autocannon firing four heavy shots: deep thuds with a metallic ring and street echo

army_tank.sound: a tank cannon firing: a hard crack and a deep boom rolling through city streets

army_rotor.sound: an attack helicopter hovering close: steady rotor blade slap over a turbine whine

army_jet.sound: a fighter jet flying low overhead: a rising roar, a loud crack overhead, a falling rumble going away

army_rocket.sound: a salvo of rockets launching: a fast string of whooshes and hissing exhaust

army_explosion.sound: an artillery shell exploding in a street: a crack, a boom, debris rattling down

army_bomb.sound: a big bomb exploding: a huge deep blast with a long rolling rumble

army_hit.sound: a tank shell striking the thick armoured hide of a giant monster: a dull heavy thud and a ringing crack

army_artillery.sound: artillery firing far away: a deep muffled thump rolling over a city

army_whistle.sound: an incoming artillery shell whistling through the air, falling in pitch, no explosion

amb_rain_light.sound: light rain and drizzle on a city street: soft hiss with fine pattering drops

amb_rain_heavy.sound: a heavy downpour in a city: dense roar of rain, splashing, gurgling gutters

amb_wind_gust.sound: wind at street level between buildings: gusts swelling and dying away, a faint whistle

thunder_near.sound: a lightning strike very close: a sharp crack of thunder, then a long rolling rumble

thunder_far.sound: distant thunder: a low long roll of thunder far away, no crack
